cases.description: Should trigger: determine the next semantic version bump
cases.input: Since v1.1.0 we merged a breaking API change (removed a deprecated endpoint) and two bug fixes. What version should we release?
cases.expect: Applies SemVer bump rules — breaking change forces MAJOR — then walks the release workflow
assertions: Explains MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH mapping and the highest-category tiebreaker
Cites the rule: once published, never modify a version's tag

cases.description: Should trigger: changelog maintenance per Keep a Changelog
cases.input: Update the changelog for our next release: promote the Unreleased section, add the date, and link the version header.
cases.expect: Uses the Keep a Changelog structure (Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security), promotes [Unreleased], adds date and tag comparison link
assertions: Promotes [Unreleased] to the new version header
Adds the release date and tag comparison link
Verifies every change in the release has a changelog entry

cases.description: Should trigger: tag a release and create a GitHub/GitLab release
cases.input: Cut v1.2.0: update manifests, commit, create a signed tag, push, and publish release notes.
cases.expect: Executes the release workflow: version bump in manifest files, chore(release) commit, signed tag, push, gh release create with notes file
assertions: Updates version in package.json / pyproject.toml / VERSION
Creates a signed tag (git tag -s v1.2.0)
Uses gh release create with --notes-file CHANGELOG.md
Merges the release branch with --no-ff and deletes it

cases.description: Should trigger: hotfix release workflow off the release tag
cases.input: Critical production bug — we need a patch release now, and the fix must also land on main.
cases.expect: Runs the hotfix workflow: branch from the release tag (not main), cherry-pick the fix, patch bump, changelog entry under [Fixed], then cherry-pick back to main
assertions: Branches from the release tag, not main
Increments the patch version and adds a [Fixed] changelog entry
Cherry-picks the hotfix back to main after release

cases.description: Should trigger: rollback planning before deployment
cases.input: We're deploying v2.0.0 with a schema migration. Prepare the rollback plan.
cases.expect: Documents the rollback plan: trigger signal, rollback command, reversible migration check, verification, communication; selects the right strategy (DB migration revert here)
assertions: Records rollback trigger, command, and verification steps
Checks whether the data migration is reversible
Selects database migration revert as the strategy for schema changes

cases.description: Not trigger: ordinary feature development with no release intent
cases.input: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page and write tests for it.
cases.expect: Does not enter the release workflow; handled as regular feature work
assertions: No version bump, tagging, or changelog workflow invoked
No release branch or CI release pipeline steps run
